name: Jules
summary: Google's asynchronous AI coding agent for GitHub repositories.
description: Jules is Google's autonomous coding agent: it connects to GitHub repositories, works on tasks in the background in a cloud VM, and returns changes as pull requests to review. It differs from in-editor assistants by being fully asynchronous. The free plan includes 15 tasks per day and 3 concurrent tasks; higher limits come with Google AI Pro ($19.99/month) and Ultra.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The free plan includes 15 tasks per day and 3 concurrent tasks; higher limits come with Google AI Pro ($19.99/month) and Ultra.

howToUse.title: Give Jules a repository and a prompt
howToUse.description: The homepage says to select a GitHub repository and branch and write a prompt, or add the jules label to an issue.

howToUse.title: Review the plan
howToUse.description: Jules fetches the repository, clones it to a cloud VM, and writes a plan.

howToUse.title: Approve the diff
howToUse.description: The page says Jules then shows a diff for you to review and approve.

howToUse.title: Merge the pull request
howToUse.description: Jules opens a pull request. The page says you approve it, merge it, and publish the branch.
